seo.title: Fast Easy — Fasting Timer for iOS
seo.description: A simple fasting timer for iPhone and iPad, with widgets, a Live Activity, streaks and history. No accounts, no tracking, no subscriptions.

hero.label: Fasting Timer
hero.title: Fasting, made easy.
text: A simple fasting timer for iPhone and iPad. Start a fast in one tap, follow it from your Home Screen and Lock Screen, and see the flag fill when you reach your goal. Ink on paper, with color only where it means something. No accounts. No tracking. No subscriptions.

items.title: Fasting Plans
items.text: 13:11, 16:8, 18:6, 20:4 and 36-hour fasts, or set your own length. Pick one and tap Start, and count down to your goal or up from zero.

items.title: Widgets & Live Activity
items.text: See time to go from your Home Screen and Lock Screen. A Live Activity follows your fast in the Dynamic Island and fills its flag at your goal.

items.title: Four Dials
items.text: Classic, Clock, Segments and Minimal. Swipe the dial to switch.

items.title: Statistics & Streaks
items.text: Your current and longest streak, total hours, average length, completion rate and your week at a glance. With your permission, your weight trend from Apple Health sits alongside.

items.title: History
items.text: Every fast is kept. See how close each came to its goal, and fix a start or end time if you forgot to tap.

items.title: Make It Yours
items.text: Light, Graphite or Black, and eight accents, each with its own app icon.

sections.title: Zero data collection.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking pixels. No telemetry. Fast Easy doesn't make network requests, and your fasts never leave your device.

cta.title: Start fasting today.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
